ja: ― 水 中 専 用 G パ ー ツ 起 動 ―
『A.O.Z RE-BOOT ガンダム・インレ-くろうさぎのみた夢-』より、
水中戦用Ｇパーツ「アクア・ハンブラビＩＩ」をＨＧシリーズで商品化！一部のパーツを除いて外装を新規造形、特徴的な青い”ティターンズ仕様”を成形色で再現。
更に、別売りの「ＨＧ 1/144 バーザム（A.O.Z RE-BOOT版）」に装着させる事で、「アクア・バーザム」を再現可能！
●　新規造形を交え、水中戦用Ｇパーツ「アクア・ハンブラビＩＩ」を再現
サブアームユニットやドラムフレームが付属し、水中戦を支える支援ＭＡ「アクア・ハンブラビＩＩ」を徹底再現！
成形色の異なる「HG 1/144 アクア・ハンブラビＩＩ  (A.O.Z RE-BOOT版)（別売り）」と同じランナー形状で商品化を実現！！
●　新規構造ドラムフレームが付属。
アクア・ハンブラビIIの中核を成すドラムフレームは、各ユニットへの接続位置を変更できる構造を採用。
ジョイントの可動域が向上したことで、各MSに対応したユニット位置への配置を実現！
●　水中戦を彷彿とさせる様々なアクションポーズが可能
ハンド・アンカーはクローが可動。
基部前方に展開し、リード線を用いて射出状態を再現可能。
●　各ＭＳ装着状態を再現するジョイントパーツが付属
別売りの「ＨＧ 1/144 バーザム（A.O.Z RE-BOOT版）（別売り　プレミアムバンダイ販売アイテム）」に装着する事で、
「アクア・バーザム」を再現可能！

en: ― Underwater dedicated G parts activation ―
From “A.O.Z RE-BOOT Gundam・Inre-The dream that the black rabbit saw-”

G parts for underwater warfare "Aqua Hambrabi II " are commercialized in the HG series! The exterior is newly modeled except for some parts, and the characteristic blue " Titans specification" is reproduced in the molding color.
Furthermore, by attaching it to the separately sold "HG 1/144 Barzam (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version)", you can reproduce " Aqua Barzam"!
● Reproduce the underwater warfare G part "Aqua Hambrabi II" with new modeling
A sub-arm unit and drum frame are included, thoroughly reproducing the support MA "Aqua Hambrabi II" that supports underwater warfare!
Commercialized in the same Runner shape as "HG 1/144 Aqua Hambrabi II (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version) (sold separately)" with a different molding color! !
● Comes with a new structure drum frame.
The drum frame, which forms the core of Aqua Hambrabi II, has a structure that allows you to change the connection position to each unit.
By improving the range of motion of the joint, it is now possible to place the unit in a position that corresponds to each MS!
● Various action poses reminiscent of underwater battles are possible.
The claw of the hand anchor is movable.
It can be deployed in front of the base and the injection state can be reproduced using the lead wire.
● Comes with joint parts to reproduce each MS installed state.
By attaching it to the separately sold "HG 1/144 Barzam (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version) (Premium Bandai sales item sold separately)",
"Aqua Barzam" can be reproduced!
Set contents: Aqua Hambravi II [Titans specification] x 1 / Various joint parts / Display stand
(Compatible product) HG 1/144 Barzam (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version) (Premium Bandai sales item sold separately)
*This product does not include the MS body.
*To reproduce Aqua Barzam, this product and "HG 1/144 Barzam (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version) (Premium Bandai sales item sold separately)" are required.
*Runner shape is the same as "HG 1/144 Aqua Hambrabi II (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version)".
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PVC
・No adhesive is used for assembly
